verdicts.question: implementation
verdicts.evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:1889's GIT.TRAILER row was changed from 'last 20 commits carry the versionless trailer | otherwise (WARN)' to 'last 20 commits carry the versionless trailer, and none carries a model-versioned one | otherwise' — the '(WARN)' removal is correct and matches Doctor.jl:549-554's deliberate FAIL. But the added clause 'and none carries a model-versioned one' is false: GIT.TRAILER's check (src/CLI/Doctor.jl:561-566, untouched by this diff) only counts commits missing the versionless trailer string; the model-versioned-trailer check is a different check, POL.COLLAPSED (Doctor.jl:545: 'a model-versioned trailer in the last 20 commits'). RULE.GIT.TRAILER's own statement (policy/git-conventions.md:10-11, policy/RULES.toml:638) says nothing about barring a model-versioned trailer either. The fix introduced a fresh false claim while correcting the one it was asked to correct.

class_surfaces.evidence: carries the newly-introduced false claim that GIT.TRAILER's own check verifies the absence of a model-versioned trailer, which src/CLI/Doctor.jl:561-566 does not do
